messages:
Olivia: Quick one — drafting a customer-facing SLA summary for NimbusHealth. They had two latency SLO misses last billing period and asked for the credit calc + a short remediation note. I sketched a template, attaching inline. Need numbers from SRE and confirmation from billing/legal before we send.

Kevin: Can you paste the sketch here? I can grab SRE metrics once I know the window.

Olivia: Sure, pasted below. Feel free to edit.
```
SLA Summary (draft):
- Customer: NimbusHealth
- Period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
- SLOs: Uptime 99.99% / P95 latency < 200ms
- Observed: Uptime 99.92% (downtime ~ 35m) / P95 latency 215ms
- Root cause: KV cache thundering during a traffic spike (initial) + fallback routing delay
- Credit calc: prorated monthly fee * penalty factor (see calc)
- Remediation: autoscale policy tweak, cache priming, routing fallback timeout lowered to 300ms
- Next steps: internal postmortem + customer enablement call
```

Sanjay: I pulled the metrics — matches what you put but add the tokenized request counts. Also note the spike happened 2026-02-18 13:12–13:47 UTC (approx).

Kevin: Adding numbers from infra: total requests 12.4M, prefix cache hit 72%, KV ops increased 4x during spike. Attaching short calc: 
```
Observed downtime: 35m -> uptime 99.92% (monthly window)
Monthly fee: $18,000
Credit formula (draft): credit = min(monthly_fee, round((SLO_uptime - observed_uptime)/SLO_uptime * monthly_fee, 2))
Example: (0.9999 - 0.9992)/0.9999 * 18000 ≈ $12,601 -> capped at monthly fee so credit = $12,601
```

Maria: Legal note — we should avoid committing to automated large credits in the initial customer message. Suggest language like: "We estimate a credit of up to $X pending final audit." Also add a link to the SLO terms.

BillingBot: Automated calc: preliminary credit estimate = $12,600. Customer invoice hold flag = false. Please confirm if you want a manual invoice adjustment.

Olivia: Good call, Maria. Proposed customer wording: "Our initial analysis indicates your account may be eligible for a credit of up to $12.6k; we will finalize following our audit and confirmation of impact to your usage." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sanjay: +1. Also include a short bullet for engineers in the note: what we changed (autoscale policy, cache priming) and what we will monitor (P95, cache hit rate).

Kevin: Ops ask: who will own the customer-facing postmortem? I can do the SRE technical annex, but need a CSM to lead the email/call.

Olivia: I will lead the customer call and email. Timeline: draft to customer by EOD Thu, internal audit completed by Tue next week, final credit communicated Wed.

Maria: I'll prepare the legal-safe phrasing and a one-paragraph escalation if they push for immediate credit.

BillingBot: Note logged: ticket #CS-2026-398 for credit audit. Assigned: billing-team.

Olivia: OK — action items: 1) Kevin/Sanjay attach final metrics + short technical annex, 2) Maria produce legal phrasing, 3) Billing to run audit and confirm final number, 4) Olivia to send draft customer email for review before EOD Thu. I'll ping people when draft is ready.

Kevin: Will upload annex in this thread by noon tomorrow.

Sanjay: I'll add the Grafana panel PNGs and the exact time-series queries.

Olivia: Thanks all. Small ask — can we include a short enablement snippet for the customer's infra team with suggested retry/backoff knobs? That helped last time.

Kevin: Yep, will include a 3-line config suggestion.

Olivia: Great. If no objections I'll post the draft here in ~6 hours. :thumbsup:
